issue_context.title: Support restore on TiFlash cluster with EBS snapshot.
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Current EBS based backup and restore doesn't support restore TiFlash enabled cluster because the volume of TiFlash didn't backup. but we can use `Alter table tiflash replica` to set the replicas after restore.

review_comments: Add a comment about the reason for setting the tiflash-count=0 and then set normal tiflash-count.
